content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Kurukshetra?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Coach for Cultural Activities posts at NIT Kurukshetra is scheduled for 29 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Coach for Cultural Activities posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MA/Master's degree in Performing Arts with a first-class division to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Coach for Cultural Activities role?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for the Coach for Cultural Activities positions across various cultural activities.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 60 years. There is no minimum age limit specified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be paid on an hourly basis, ranging from Rs. 750/- to Rs. 15,000/- per hour, depending on the specific activity and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based solely on a Walk-in Interview conducted by the National Institute of Technology Kurukshetra.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the NIT Kurukshetra located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Kurukshetra is located in Kurukshetra, Haryana, with the pincode 136119.
